title: A gerbe-like construction in gauge theory II: the case of homology tori
summary: In the previous paper, the author showed that for a smooth family $X \to \mathbb{X} \to B$ of a homotopy $K3$ surface, the obstruction for the tangent bundle along the fibers $T_B \mathbb{X}$ to have a spin structure is canonically isomorphic to the obstruction for $\mathcal{H}^+(\mathbb{X})$, the vector bundle over $B$ consisting of self-dual harmonic 2-forms, to have a spin structure. In this paper, we show an analogous result for homology tori with odd determinant. The strategy for proof is similar to the case of homotopy $K3$ surfaces: take the determinant line bundle of the…
